title: Cloud channel asset sync and launch orchestration for AWS/Azure/GCP
creator: Ethan Zhao
description: Coordinated launch for Redwood Inference on AWS Marketplace, Azure Marketplace, and GCP Marketplace focused on synchronizing listing assets, release notes, SKUs, and billing metadata. This ticket covers cross-team orchestration (product, eng, security, legal, marketing, partner ops), a canonical asset bundle, a single source of truth for release notes, and the launch runbook for each channel. Goal: enable simultaneous or staged marketplace activations with consistent messaging, verified billing integration, and no regressions in runtime behavior or compliance requirements.
acceptance_criteria: Canonical asset bundle (logos, 1-pager, lead images, product description) uploaded to all three marketplaces and stored in Drive under /Marketplaces/2026-Q1/Redwood-ChannelBundle-v1
Release notes file (marketplace_release_notes_2026-03-22.md) published to Confluence and copied to each marketplace listing field; changelog entries mapped to marketplace short/long fields

Billing SKUs for hosted and dedicated products verified with finance, and mapping for usage vs reserved capacity confirmed in vendor consoles (AWS Seller Central, Azure Marketplace, GCP Partner Portal)
Legal & security sign-off recorded (Confluence checklist signed) and export of required compliance artifacts attached to each marketplace submission
Support & docs links validated and dual-tested from marketplace flows to Redwood Console and docs.redwood.ai
Rollout runbooks completed for: (a) immediate launch, (b) staged launch with canary region, (c) rollback path to previous listing version
All metadata fields (pricing, trial credits, pricing tiers, SLAs) are consistent across listings or documented exceptions exist and approved
Post-launch telemetry dashboard (Console > Marketplace Launches) set up to monitor installs, latency regressions, and billing anomalies for 72 hours post-activation

Create per-marketplace runbook (AWS, Azure, GCP) including step-by-step publish and rollback directions
QA: smoke test listing links, screenshots, and integration flows (owner: QA)
Schedule go/no-go sync 48 hours before target date and 2 hours before publish
